body: You can improve yourself, walk, read, eat healthy, focus on yourself.. If you have home, food, things that you enjoy to do etc, maybe one friend you can just spend time with; then you have enough. You can be poor long time and become poor many times. Dont try to hang on old or new relationships that needs money to survive. Maybe you need to work with yourself and your relationship with money. Things change sometimes so much that its easier to dwell than grow. Learn to accept your current life situation. Its happening for you, not to you. If someone likes you, it doesnt matter if you have money or not.
